local_userspace_evidence.head: a47ab7c0d4be9e89459a268eab314cd3c758ec77
findings: Utils.cpp IsFilesystemSupported reads /proc/filesystems; IsSdcardfsUsed requires that registration plus the property.
Both EmulatedVolume constructors set mUseSdcardFs from that predicate.
EmulatedVolume::doMount executes sdcardfs only with mUseSdcardFs and owner user 0; isVisible branch calls MountUserFuse and marks mFuseMounted. FUSE is not conditional on sdcardfs presence.

limitations: Static retirement and source preservation review; no Android OS build, storage mounting, permission isolation or filesystem runtime test performed. Entire deleted sdcardfs bodies were accounted for as whole-file retirements, not individually certified safe. No new code change requires a rebuild; build 145 artifacts remain the latest compiled source.
